newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Roadway estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Roadway estimate raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Wednesday it increased its 1997 earnings estimate for Roadway Express Inc to $1.55 a share from $1.40 to reflect a stronger tone of business and a more favorable rate environment.
-- Roadway is seeing its emphasis on high-density lanes pay off, with a tonnage gain of 8.7 percent in the first quarter and a yield improvement of about 5.5 percent, Gruntal said.
-- Roadway's acquisition of Canada's Reimer Express business is also providing what Gruntal called a "shot of adrenaline" to Roadway's Canadian operation.
-- Its shares were off 3/8 at 18-1/2 Wednesday afternoon.
